body:
## Curvature Guides the Solver

The loss forms a smooth bowl, but the bowl is steeper in some directions than others. A solver can use both slope and local bend to choose a smarter step.

Newton-style methods use a curvature table to rescale updates. For large feature sets, practical solvers use products and approximations instead of storing the whole table.

Sparse data and regularization change which solver is practical. Convergence messages matter: an unfinished fit can return numbers that look valid but are not settled.
common_mistakes: Treating the output probability as certainty.
Using the default threshold without considering error costs.
Explaining an odds change as the same-sized probability change.

real_world_usage: It is a strong, explainable baseline for binary classification.
